login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to DripNepal
login.intro: Use the email and password of your DripNepal account.
login.email_rule: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
login.invalid: Invalid email or password. Check both and try again.
login.suspended_body: You can't sign in while your account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
login.password_changed_body: Sign in with your new password. Devices that were signed in before are signed out.
login.closed_body: You were signed out on every device. We've emailed you what happens next. If you didn't mean to do this, contact support soon: staff can reopen the account until your details are deleted.
signup.title: Create an account
signup.heading: Create your account
signup.intro: Shop from independent fashion shops across Nepal. We'll email you a link to verify your address.
signup.full_name_rule: Enter your name, up to {max} characters.
signup.email_rule: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
signup.password_help: Use {min} to {max} characters. A few words you will remember work well.
signup.password_rule: Enter a password of {min} to {max} characters.
signup.phone_help: A Nepali mobile number, such as 98XXXXXXXX. You can also add it later.
signup.phone_rule: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 96, 97 or 98.
signup.age_rule: Confirm that you are 18 or older to create an account.
signup.marketing_email: Email me offers and news from DripNepal
signup.marketing_sms: Text me offers and news from DripNepal
signup.marketing_help: Both are off unless you tick them. You can change them at any time.
signup.legal_intro: By creating an account, you accept the terms of use and confirm that you have read the privacy notice:
verify.title: Verify your email
verify.checking.heading: Checking your link…
verify.verified.heading: Your email is verified
verify.verified.guest_body: Your account is ready. Sign in to start shopping.
verify.already.heading: Your email is already verified
verify.already.body: There is nothing more to do.
verify.invalid.heading: This link has expired
verify.invalid.body: Each link works once, and stops working when it expires or when a newer link is sent.
verify.failed.heading: We couldn't check your link
verify.sent.heading: Check your email
verify.sent.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your email address.
verify.guest.heading: Verify your email
verify.guest.body: Open the link in the email we sent you to verify your address.
verify.pending.heading: Verify your email
verify.pending.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your address.
verify.delay: It can take a few minutes to arrive. If you can't find it, check your spam folder.
verify.no_link: Didn't get the email, or has the link expired?
verify.sign_in_for_link: Sign in to get a new link
verify.resent: We sent a new link to {email}. Links sent before it no longer work.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your DripNepal account and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.email_rule: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
forgot.sent.heading: Check your email
forgot.sent.body: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent it a link to set a new password. The link works once, and the email says when it expires.
forgot.sent.delay: It can take a few minutes to arrive. If you can't find it, check your spam folder.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.heading: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for your DripNepal account. You'll sign in with it afterwards.
reset.password_help: Use {min} to {max} characters. A few words you will remember work well.
reset.password_rule: Enter a password of {min} to {max} characters.
reset.invalid.heading: This link has expired
reset.invalid.body: Each link works once, and stops working when it expires or when a newer link is sent. Ask for a new one below.
reset.missing.heading: This link is not complete
reset.missing.body: Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one below.
mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.sign_in.heading: Sign in to continue
mfa.sign_in.intro: Sign in with your DripNepal staff account first. If you opened a setup link, it stays ready while you sign in.
mfa.not_staff.heading: This page is for staff accounts
mfa.not_staff.body: You're signed in as {email}, which isn't a DripNepal staff account. Sign out, then sign in here with your staff account; a setup link you opened stays ready.
mfa.enrol.heading: Set up two-step verification
mfa.enrol.intro: Staff accounts need an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis, before the admin area opens.
mfa.enrol.no_link: Open the setup link in the email we sent you. It works for 24 hours, once. If it has expired, ask the platform team for a new one.
mfa.enrol.invalid_link: This setup link has expired or has already been used. Ask the platform team for a new one.
mfa.enrol.password_help: We ask for it again before showing your setup key.
mfa.enrol.step_add: 1. Add DripNepal to your authenticator app
mfa.enrol.open_app_help: On this phone, this link opens your app with everything filled in.
mfa.enrol.key_label: Or enter this setup key in the app
mfa.enrol.key_help: Choose "Enter a setup key" (or "Enter code manually"), type the key, and pick "Time based". Keep it private: it is shown only now.
mfa.enrol.step_code: 2. Enter the code the app shows
mfa.enrol.restart: Start again with a new key
mfa.enrolled.title: Two-step verification is on
mfa.enrolled.body: Wait for the code in your app to change, then enter the new one to continue.
mfa.challenge.heading: Enter your code
mfa.challenge.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for DripNepal.
mfa.challenge.lost: Lost your phone or authenticator app? Ask the DripNepal platform team to reset it.
mfa.code_rule: Enter the 6 digits your app shows.
